headline: Approved a $270,000 refinance for Las Delicious and approved a financial report covering $200,000 in city funds.
summary: Members approved a $270,000 refinance for Las Delicious, subject to conditions including a six-month SBA or CORE training and a required CPA hire. They also approved a financial report covering $200,000 received from the City of Pawtucket. The Commercial Loan Delinquency Policy Draft was not discussed and will be taken up at a future meeting.

decision_titles: PRA financial report and budget update
plain_text:
Pawtucket Redevelopment Agency 
Meeting Minutes 
August 25, 2026, 12:15 PM 
 
 
Call to Order  
The meeting was called to order at 12:15 p.m. 
 
Roll Call  
A quorum was established. In attendance:  Larry Monastesse, Brian Murtha, Tim O’Riley, 
Mark McLaughlin  
 
Others:  Jason Pezzullo, Tim Chapman, Michael Cassidy, Mary Bourdeau, Mark Goudreau, 
Irene Santos, Jacob Alderman, Nico Corbo, Liceth Gutierrez, Exneider Vasquez, Henry 
Vasquez – Zoom:  Ben Smith, Patrick Anderson 
  
Public Input Session - None 
 
Minutes of Previous Meeting – August 4, 2026  
Mr. Murtha made a motion to approve the minutes of August 4, 2026, seconded by Mr. 
O’Riley.  Motion carried 4-0. 
 
Consent Agenda  
Mr. Murtha made a motion to approve the consent agenda, seconded by Mr. O’Riley.  Motion 
carried 4-0. 
 
PRA Financial Information and Budget Update  
 
Ms. Gorman gave an update on the PRA financials.  PRA has received $200,000 from City of 
Pawtucket to cover operating expenses. Of the $200,000,  $120,000 will be transferred back 
to the Commercial Loan Account and the remaining balance will be used to cover Fiscal 26 
Blackstone Valley Tourism expenses. Mr. Murtha made a motion to approve the financial 
report, seconded by Mr. O’Riley.  Motion passed 4-0. 
 
 
Old Business 
Commercial Loans Delinquency Policy Draft  
There was no discussed on the Commercial Loan Delinquency Policy Draft.  This item will 
be discussed at a future meeting. 
 
25 Mendon Avenue Update 
Mr. Goudreau stated quotes are being received for the interior demo and mold remediation.  
One quote remains outstanding. 
 
 
Executive Session  
Mr. Murtha made a motion to enter Executive Session pursuant to RIGL 42-46-5(a)(2), 
sessions pertaining to collective bargaining or litigation — Item A: Las Delicias Request and 
B. Cape Verdean Museum Request — and pursuant to RIGL 42-46-5(a)(7), a matter related
to the investment of public funds where premature disclosure would adversely affect the 
public interest — Item A: Downtown Gateway Update — seconded by Mr. O’Riley. The 
motion carried 4-0. 
Mr. Murtha made a motion to seal the minutes of the executive session, seconded by Mr. 
McLaughlin.  Motion carried 4-0. 
 
Mr. O’Riley made a motion to return to Open Session, seconded by Mr. Murtha.  Motion 
carried 5-0. 
 
 
Upon returning to open session, it was reported that two (2) votes were taken were taken 
during Executive Session. 
 
1.  Las Delicious – Approved refinance of $270,000 subject to technical assistance from 
SBDC, completing a six-month SBA or CORE training, good standing letter from the 
Division of Taxation, loan amortization will be 240 months, title insurance, and required 
to hire a CPA 
 
2.  Cape Verdean Museum Requested that the offer from the PRA for a modification of loan 
repayment be changed to a forgiveness of the loan.  Motion was made not to change the 
offer of the loan modification previously made to Cape Verdean Museum.  
 
 
Adjournment 
Mr. Murtha made a motion to adjourn the meeting, seconded by Mr. O’Riley. The motion 
carried 5-0.
